In [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], a toxic '''flesh-eating bacterium''' was accidentally released from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[bacteriological research outpost]] in the [[Haxim's city|capital city]] of [[Haxim's province]] on [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. It quickly spread, leading to riots in the city. To quell the dispersion of the bacterium, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered for an [[Bombardment of Falleen|orbital bombardment]] on the city, neutralizing the virus. 200,000 [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] perished, but estimates stated billions more could have died if the bacterium had continued to spread.
